key.name: theme
key.description: Controls whether Riteed uses the system appearance, a light appearance, or a dark appearance.

key.name: word-wrap
key.description: Controls whether long lines wrap inside the editor.

key.name: show-line-numbers
key.description: Controls whether Riteed shows line numbers in the editor gutter.

key.name: show-minimap
key.description: Controls whether Riteed shows a document overview minimap beside the editor.

key.name: editor-palette
key.description: Controls the color palette used for editor buffers.

key.name: window-palette
key.description: Stores the previous window palette setting for compatibility. Riteed now derives window chrome from the editor palette family and app style.

key.name: highlight-current-line
key.description: Controls whether Riteed highlights the active line in editable documents.

key.name: autosave-enabled
key.description: Controls whether Riteed automatically saves already-saved writable files after edits.

key.name: insert-spaces-instead-of-tabs
key.description: Controls whether pressing Tab inserts spaces instead of a literal tab character.

key.name: tab-width
key.description: Controls how many columns a tab character occupies in the editor.

key.name: indent-width
key.description: Controls how many columns automatic indentation and indent actions use in the editor.

key.name: editor-font
key.description: Stores the preferred monospace font description for editor text and the minimap. An empty value uses the default monospace font.

key.name: window-width
key.description: Stores the last width used for the main window.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Stores the last height used for the main window.

key.name: recent-files
key.description: Stores the most recently opened local text files as URIs, newest first.

key.name: session-files
key.description: Stores the currently open saved local text files as URIs in tab order.

key.name: session-selected-file
key.description: Stores the URI of the selected saved tab. An empty string means no saved tab is selected.

key.name: git-user-name
key.description: Stores the Git author name Riteed passes to sandboxed Git commits after explicit user action.

key.name: git-user-email
key.description: Stores the Git author email Riteed passes to sandboxed Git commits after explicit user action.

key.name: source-control-view-mode
key.description: Controls whether the source control changes view uses a folder tree or a flat list.

key.name: compare-view-mode
key.description: Controls whether compare review prefers split view, unified view, or adaptive switching based on available width.

key.name: compare-collapse-unchanged
key.description: Controls whether unchanged stretches between compare hunks are collapsed by default.

key.name: compare-context-lines
key.description: Controls how many unchanged lines are kept around each visible compare hunk.

key.name: compare-ignore-leading-trailing-whitespace
key.summary: Ignore Leading and Trailing Whitespace in Compare
key.description: Controls whether compare review hides changes that only add or remove leading or trailing whitespace.

key.name: compare-word-wrap
key.description: Controls whether unified compare review wraps long lines. It does not affect normal editor word wrap.

key.name: project-folder-uri
key.description: Stores the last selected project folder as a URI. An empty string means no folder is remembered.

key.name: project-folder-display-name
key.description: Stores the display name for the remembered project folder.

key.name: project-sidebar-visible
key.description: Controls whether the project sidebar is shown when a project folder is active.

key.name: project-show-hidden
key.description: Controls whether the project tree shows dot-prefixed hidden files and folders.
